newsitem.title: UK: M&G sees millennium systems cost at 5 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: M&G sees millennium systems cost at 5 mln stg.

text.p: Fund manager M&G Group Plc said on Thursday it would cost some five million sterling to ready its systems for the change in the date at the end of the century.
It said in a statement accompanying interim results it aimed to have completed all the work and testing by the end of 1998.
"We envisage that the project will cost the group five million stg over the next 18 months," it said. It started work on the project in the second half of 1996.

Because most computers were originally programmed to recognise only the two final digits in a year, such as 97 for 1997, they will recognise the year 2000 as 00, and read this as 1900 -- unless they have been reprogrammed.
Experts estimate that it could cost $300-$600 billion to correct the problem worldwide.
